links.comparator_used: Baseline GPT-4, MedPaLM and Claude outputs without the ChainTrust-LLM risk detection and trust calibration layer (implied baseline)
links.outcome: Hallucination rate in medical LLM outputs, trust calibration accuracy and inter-rater agreement
links.effect: Hallucination rates reduced by up to 64.8%; trust calibration accuracy improved by 23.4%; Fleiss' k rose from 0.65 to 0.87
links.tradeoff: Blockchain logging added an average latency of 211 ms per transaction
links.quote: Extensive evaluation using GPT-4, MedPaLM, and Claude across 300 curated medical prompts demonstrates that ChainTrust-LLM reduces hallucination rates by up to 64.8%, improves trust calibration accuracy by 23.4%, and enhances inter-rater agreement (Fleiss’ k) from 0.65 to 0.87.

design_hint: expert feedback trust calibration with blockchain audit logging
